types.description: Three-pole thermal-magnetic motor protection breaker, rotary handle, 13–18 A adjustment; bare device

modelingNotes: Manufacturer order spelling GV2P20; source GV2-P20 retained. Historical 2017 catalog exact row confirms 13–18 A rotary model; hyphen treated as presentation separator (research.md S3).

Bare breaker only. Verified pairs 1/L1–2/T1, 3/L2–4/T2, 5/L3–6/T3. Common mechanical operation and thermal/magnetic release shown in exact-product sheet p.11. Auxiliary contacts and release accessories are separate orders.
Open normal_state denotes the illustrated OFF state. Ganged relations are mechanical; neither pole functions nor release metadata establishes permanent electrical continuity.
13–18 A thermal adjustment; 18 A upper capability is not an installation setting. AC 50/60 Hz, Ue capability 690 V; no nominal circuit voltage assigned.
Magnetic threshold unresolved for historical unit: 2017 exact-order sheet gives 223 A, current exact-order sheet 341 A. No scalar threshold or protective simulation is modeled; see research.md S1/S2.

2017 Icu (IEC 60947-2): 100 kA at 230/240 V AC, 50 kA at 400/415 V, 20 kA at 440 V, 10 kA at 500 V, 4 kA at 690 V. Corresponding Ics: 100%, 50%, 75%, 75%, 100% of Icu. No unconditional breaking-capacity scalar.

Screw clamps: two solid conductors 1–6 mm², flexible without ferrule 1.5–6 mm², flexible with ferrule 1–4 mm²; tightening 1.7 N·m. External wiring and application suitability remain engineering decisions.

connectionCoverage.notes: Six main screw-clamp terminals in the exact GV2P20 sheet circuit diagram. Bare device has no depicted auxiliary, coil, PE, neutral, shield or communication connection. Separately ordered accessories and panel bonding are excluded.
